title: Investigation on the mechanism of 2,3,4',5-Tetrahydroxystilbene 2-o-D-glucoside in the treatment of inflammation based on network pharmacology.
authors: Sun, Ling; Wang, Bixu; Sun, Tong; Zhou, Fangmei; Zhu, Bingqi; Li, Chang; Wan, Haitong; Ding, Zhishan
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和分子对接研究中药单体TSG的抗炎机制，虽涉及蛋白靶点对接但非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Inflammation is the pathogenesis of various chronic diseases plaguing clinic for years.Fallopia multiflora (Thunb.) is a traditional Chinese herbal medicine with a long history of application in detoxification and anti-inflammation. 2,3,4',5-Tetrahydroxystilbene 2-o-D-glucoside (TSG) is a main active compound of F. multiflora. However, the mechanism of TSG in the treatment of inflammation remains unknown. METHODS: Network pharmacology and molecular docking were employed to explore the mechanism of anti-inflammatory effect of TSG. Potential targets of TSG and inflammation were obtained from Swiss Target Prediction, Pharm Mapper, and GeneCards database. Protein-protein interaction (PPI) networks, GO and KEGG pathway enrichment analysis were performed to elucidate the interaction of targets. Moreover, the anti-inflammatory effect of TSG was validated by in vitro experiments using flow cytometry, RT-qPCR, Western blot, and immunocytochemistry assays. RESULTS: PPI network and gene enrichment analysis showed that TSG may exert a protein kinase binding activity, and IKBKB, MAPK1, NFKBIA, and RELA were predicted as the targets of anti-inflammation. Verified by molecular docking and Western blot, TSG may target NF-kappaB and ERK2 related signals to alleviate inflammatory damage. Furthermore, TSG effectively downregulated the expression of inflammatory cytokine, the nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65, and the production of reactive oxygen species (ROS). CONCLUSION: TSG possesses significant anti-inflammatory effect. TSG may display a protein kinase binding activity and target NF-kappaB and ERK2 related signals to treat the inflammation. This work may enlighten the potential application of TSG in anti-inflammation and indicate network pharmacology was an effective tool for the further study of TCM.
abstract_zh: 背景：炎症是多种慢性疾病的发病机制，多年来一直困扰临床。何首乌（Fallopia multiflora (Thunb.)）是一种传统中草药，在解毒和抗炎方面有着悠久的应用历史。2,3,4',5-四羟基二苯乙烯-2-O-β-D-葡萄糖苷（TSG）是何首乌的主要活性化合物。然而，TSG在治疗炎症中的作用机制仍不清楚。方法：采用网络药理学和分子对接技术探讨TSG的抗炎作用机制。从Swiss Target Prediction、Pharm Mapper和GeneCards数据库获取TSG和炎症的潜在靶点。通过蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）网络、GO和KEGG通路富集分析来阐明靶点间的相互作用。此外，通过流式细胞术、RT-qPCR、Western blot和免疫细胞化学等体外实验验证了TSG的抗炎效果。结果：PPI网络和基因富集分析显示，TSG可能具有蛋白激酶结合活性，预测IKBKB、MAPK1、NFKBIA和RELA为抗炎靶点。经分子对接和Western blot验证，TSG可能靶向NF-kappaB和ERK2相关信号以减轻炎症损伤。此外，TSG有效下调了炎症细胞因子的表达、NF-kappaB p65的核转位以及活性氧（ROS）的产生。结论：TSG具有显著的抗炎作用。TSG可能通过蛋白激酶结合活性并靶向NF-kappaB和ERK2相关信号来治疗炎症。这项工作可能为TSG在抗炎方面的潜在应用提供启示，并表明网络药理学是进一步研究中药的有效工具。
